summary: A 5-day family-friendly Seoul itinerary covering traditional heritage, modern neighborhoods, shopping, parks, museums, and famous attractions across Hongdae, Jongno, Itaewon, Yongsan, Seongsu, and Jamsil.

days.theme: Jongno traditional culture and royal history

pois.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace (경복궁)
pois.notes: Explore Korea's grand royal palace, traditional architecture, and changing of the guard ceremony.

pois.name: Bukchon Hanok Village (북촌한옥마을)
pois.notes: Walk through a preserved traditional Korean village with beautiful hanok houses and scenic alleys.

pois.name: Insadong Street (인사동 거리)
pois.notes: Enjoy traditional tea houses, craft shops, souvenirs, and Korean cultural experiences.

pois.name: Ikseon-dong Hanok Street (익선동 한옥거리)
pois.notes: Experience a blend of historic hanok buildings, trendy cafes, and local restaurants.

days.theme: Hongdae youth culture and Seongsu creative district

pois.name: Hongdae Walking Street (홍대 걷고싶은거리)
pois.notes: Enjoy street performances, shopping, cafes, and the lively atmosphere around Hongik University.

pois.name: AK Plaza Hongdae (AK플라자 홍대)
pois.notes: Shop for fashion, character goods, cosmetics, and Korean lifestyle products.

pois.name: Seongsu Cafe Street (성수 카페거리)
pois.notes: Discover Seoul's trendy district featuring unique cafes, boutiques, and renovated industrial spaces.

pois.name: Seoul Forest (서울숲)
pois.notes: Relax with family in a large urban park with walking paths, gardens, and seasonal scenery.

days.theme: Itaewon diversity and Yongsan cultural attractions

pois.name: Itaewon Main Street (이태원 거리)
pois.notes: Explore an international neighborhood with diverse restaurants, cafes, and unique shops.

pois.name: Leeum Museum of Art (리움미술관)
pois.notes: Discover Korean traditional art and contemporary masterpieces in a world-class museum.

pois.name: National Museum of Korea (국립중앙박물관)
pois.notes: Learn about Korean history through extensive exhibitions, artifacts, and family-friendly galleries.

pois.name: Yongsan Family Park (용산가족공원)
pois.notes: Take a peaceful walk in a spacious park suitable for children and family relaxation.

pois.name: Lotte World Adventure (롯데월드 어드벤처)
pois.notes: Spend a fun family day enjoying rides, performances, and indoor attractions at Seoul's famous theme park.

pois.name: Lotte World Mall (롯데월드몰)
pois.notes: Explore luxury shops, local brands, restaurants, and entertainment facilities.

pois.name: Seoul Sky (서울스카이)
pois.notes: Enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Seoul from the observation deck inside Lotte World Tower.

days.theme: Relaxed Seoul experience with shopping and local neighborhoods

pois.name: Mangwon Market (망원시장)
pois.notes: Try various Korean snacks and experience a local traditional market atmosphere.

pois.name: Yeonnam-dong Street (연남동 거리)
pois.notes: Walk through a charming neighborhood filled with cafes, small shops, and quiet residential alleys.

pois.name: Gyeongui Line Forest Park (경의선숲길)
pois.notes: Enjoy a relaxing stroll through an urban park connecting Hongdae and Yeonnam areas.

pois.name: Myeongdong Street (명동거리)
pois.notes: Finish the trip with Korean cosmetics, fashion shopping, and famous street food.
